// diagnostic

E0311

This value does not provide the requested method, or a static/instance call uses the wrong receiver form

What

This value does not provide the requested method, or a static/instance call uses the wrong receiver form

Why

Method lookup follows the receiver's actual method set; static methods belong to types and instance methods belong to values

Fix

use the receiver form named by the diagnostic, or correct the method name

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0311: tests/ui/args_spec_bad_flag_arity.stderr.

Error [E1301]: `flag` expects 2 arguments (name, help), got 1
  --> tests/ui/args_spec_bad_flag_arity.jet:5:25
    |
  5 |     spec :: args.spec().flag("verbose")
    |                         ^^^^
 Why: `ArgsSpec.flag(name, help)` registers a boolean flag like `--verbose`
 Fix: pass exactly two strings: the flag name and a help description
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1301

Error [E0311]: `flag` isn't a method on this value
  --> tests/ui/args_spec_bad_flag_arity.jet:7:18
    |
  7 |     print(parsed.flag("verbose"))
    |                  ^^^^
 Why: this `Int` value has no instance method named `flag`
 Fix: check the spelling of `flag`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0311
